inputs.label: Trigger
inputs.description: Any signal here unlocks the gate and fires Out once

outputs.label: Out
outputs.description: Fires once when the gate is first triggered

inputs.label: Value
inputs.description: The value to test — connect from any output

outputs.label: Then (true)
outputs.description: Fires with the input value when the condition is true

outputs.label: Else (false)
outputs.description: Fires with the input value when the condition is false

inputs.label: Trigger
inputs.description: Activates the named scene when any signal arrives

inputs.label: Trigger
inputs.description: Deactivates the named scene when any signal arrives

inputs.label: Enable
inputs.description: Enables keyboard input on the terminal

inputs.label: Disable
inputs.description: Disables keyboard input and resets to waiting screen

outputs.label: Successful Outcome
outputs.description: Fires when the app reports a successful outcome

outputs.label: Unsuccessful Outcome
outputs.description: Fires when the app reports a failed outcome

outputs.label: Signal
outputs.description: Fires once when the scene is activated

inputs.label: Activate
inputs.description: Starts the lock — connect from an RFID Auth or other trigger

inputs.label: Encoder Step
inputs.description: Receives turn steps from a Rotary Encoder (+1 right, -1 left)

inputs.label: Confirm (Click)
inputs.description: Locks the current digit and advances phase — same effect as reversing direction

outputs.label: Current Count
outputs.description: The current dial count (0-99) for the active phase

outputs.label: 8-Digit Text
outputs.description: 8-character string for a MAX7219 display — two digits per phase

outputs.label: On Target
outputs.description: Fires when the dial count matches the target number for the current phase

outputs.label: Code Correct
outputs.description: Fires when all four locked digits match the configured code

outputs.label: Code Wrong
outputs.description: Fires when the locked digits do not match the configured code

inputs.label: Card UID
inputs.description: Receives a card UID string — connect from an RFID Reader

outputs.label: Card Accepted
outputs.description: Fires when the scanned UID is in the valid UIDs list

outputs.label: Card Rejected
outputs.description: Fires when the scanned UID is not in the valid UIDs list

inputs.label: Password Input
inputs.description: Receives a password string to check against the configured password

outputs.label: Password Correct
outputs.description: Fires when the submitted password matches

outputs.label: Max Attempts Reached
outputs.description: Fires when the maximum number of failed attempts is exceeded

inputs.label: Step 1
inputs.description: First thing that must happen

inputs.label: Step 2
inputs.description: Second — only accepted after Step 1

inputs.label: Step 3
inputs.description: Third — only accepted after Step 2

inputs.label: Step 4
inputs.description: Fourth — only accepted after Step 3

inputs.label: Step 5
inputs.description: Fifth — only accepted after Step 4

inputs.label: Step 6
inputs.description: Sixth — only accepted after Step 5

outputs.label: Complete
outputs.description: Fires when all steps are done in the correct order

outputs.label: Out of Order
outputs.description: Fires when a step arrives before it is expected — checklist resets

inputs.label: Start
inputs.description: Starts the countdown from the configured duration

inputs.label: Reset
inputs.description: Stops and resets the timer back to the configured duration

outputs.label: Tick (each second)
outputs.description: Fires once per second while the timer is running

outputs.label: Time Up
outputs.description: Fires when the countdown reaches zero

inputs.label: Trigger
inputs.description: Any incoming signal triggers the output

outputs.label: Value Out
outputs.description: Emits the configured value
